{{- /* Type pill at the start of the chip row above the H1 (api-reference-panel.html). Only the rare "read to learn" types carry one: tutorials (learn by doing) and explanations (understand a topic). They set them apart from the how-tos and reference pages that make up most of the site, which stay unlabeled, so the pill keeps its signal. Same shape as the API chips, tinted with the type's token. Class strings stay literal so Tailwind compiles them. Renders nothing for any other diataxis_type. */ -}} {{- $pills := dict "tutorial" (dict "label" "Tutorial" "class" "border-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-diataxis-tutorial)_40%,var(--color-gd-bg))] bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-diataxis-tutorial)_8%,var(--color-gd-bg))] text-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-diataxis-tutorial)_60%,var(--color-gd-text))]") "explanation" (dict "label" "Explanation" "class" "border-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-diataxis-explanation)_40%,var(--color-gd-bg))] bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-diataxis-explanation)_8%,var(--color-gd-bg))] text-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--color-diataxis-explanation)_60%,var(--color-gd-text))]") -}} {{- with index $pills (.Params.diataxis_type | default "") -}} {{ .label }} {{- end -}}
